integrity_notes: The matrix and sampler are specified explicitly, the limiting parameters and quantifiers are proved analytically, and a standalone exact-arithmetic verifier is provided; finite tests are not treated as proofs.
scientific_limitations: Exact arithmetic; a three-dimensional real SPD Jacobi family with a two-vector Krylov space and exactly two sampled coordinates.
Sharp imaginary-part envelope is family-specific at fixed spectral half-width, not a bound for all sketches and matrices.
The general possibility of nonreal sketched Ritz values on symmetric input was established earlier; this contribution concerns E-optimal selection and a sharp classified family.
Independent validation has not been performed.
title: Optimal two-row sketches can produce nonreal Ritz values for condition-two SPD systems
